--- >Every part of the city has its own little details and unique characteristics; even within the city itself, there are areas, neighbourhoods, beaches and parks that seem to belong to a different city altogether. --- ![Image_1776727595637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqq2XR1cvku8NVyCs8xoHSekN9xvvUmWvkaRPUe1fB55spR6EkVJM3E6SseUW6YvYqG.jpg) --- So far, I’ve visited several beaches; in some cases, I’ve gone specifically to one of them, and in others, I’ve taken a long walk along several, when they aren’t too long. But in this case, I’m bringing you one of the most popular beaches; in fact, I believe, in my opinion and based on my visits, that it’s the second most popular in Málaga. The first is La Malagueta. I usually prefer quieter beaches for relaxing and enjoying the sea, and although at first, when I arrived in Málaga, I used to go to the most famous and touristy one, it was always very crowded, so for quite some time I chose to walk a bit further and head to La Caleta. --- ![20250912_172224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYdMTrVQzkGhYKZCu2mBpVcFVG9nxDzFvLBPu4jFggYFYn2piV1KLVgk8bFQxyP38ro.jpg) ![20250912_172227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243Lxi8U36t9Q9iF2FW2XEDevgHUvikxKaNWDtUCxUgvTdc9nj3Cdd3gdzRQn9h77D4pb.jpg) ![20250912_172234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8oasjGsKp84tNxTtBiuinHf7aqLXgebwTnbH45555Mo9GUqsAwUzszeUZi6qUwG4td.jpg) ![20250922_164416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKrQJ4orJDiTUM9wcK4Hyrb5TtiV9sBGXUeR6y6RtWjohZtTtrJcfrVA82zjiw5zwo5.jpg) ![20250922_174524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4c45gc7kLUjxZ8NjPXRpuSJFkRzPj1cseqmtoDBsiugTT9uQS85mL4baV9fcwHZXS1.jpg) ![20250922_174507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241QTNFMsQyu2orvAL6gxdWxoLUnkueopt151XWu3SLseWhhkn2R6jzKhHEJxtVWXVGrY.jpg) ![20250922_174627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYjfrkbne36RDUh9B8tQRujEnDL23dVgY4TswXioZWtTC5Qe935qGQUmP7i3P2a5JhY.jpg) ![20250922_174631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGa9KSPMgvH9b7SdGJxMvm7MbHdjuBZwbtvoTiSMYy3i5xodmtWJmubGXp1zMKgk4kc.jpg) --- Walking along its promenade offers the chance to look out over the Mediterranean Sea on one side and the various buildings on the other, many of them hotels or places exclusively for tourists, although there are people who have flats overlooking the sea. That’s the best bit of all. The sea is always my favourite thing to see on my walk, but this beach is full of beach bars with excellent restaurants and plenty of space, where you can choose to eat inside or on the terraces with an incredible view of the water and the horizon. --- ![20250922_174734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1nzhcKnUkbLqbGRpbMzyqRcu3wNqxiYnCAzCv9kPoeRXoKEX5xSVb9hRAdWbxJxRHj.jpg) ![20250922_174642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sdfpngHUaa9Rbt6BjVeiXy2GzVtiuiR4fSdJU4PYcAc99wNFEq47yVmY88XWfGdNUsj.jpg) ![20250922_174655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVEhKKc9sPLLUiXBnYKJA4djL1TaaBLdnEvR4wD1K2Qtdh5MiUs1w6epqW5NDfWRMSR.jpg) ![20250922_174736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd5nTzXoxFNLdJmmFX2KimP27GRhgAYvSTUodbk32rq6ZTboz6fzHzfkrEJsLQcNXes.jpg) ![20250922_175047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245ca8mn4bpcpo4SjELecKLzXSM497WvrL6jCfY32ePqBxtwuhTDPCt5doHRSSu5JvMgu.jpg) ![20250922_175332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245TEGnq3Wd3JuEpV6eUPVXcRjC8xekMuiGGyAjiWXGthgEbnJNyDdjfEvKEdNYAaA2Wi.jpg) ![20250922_175400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odaCjverZJV8gwekhv6YR5AqKqcE86fEhHs5gM12ocnHdUMLE3xv4LLgMcQXp88ZzM.jpg) --- It’s a beach full of green spaces near the promenade, with plenty of palm trees, so you can enjoy the shade in the height of summer, have a picnic, or make the most of the sunny spots. To be honest, I prefer the sunny spots; I love sunbathing whenever I can. According to the information signs that appear every now and then on the beach, it stretches for 1,000 metres, although it seems much longer. I usually walk from west to east, but on this occasion I started the other way round. --- ![20250922_174830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vPLieHRRSp3jQuMdH5AXc7GSHgdUzkpLXVtM1HkjJLzBXJ4ZeGMvwuoDJ7dxde8fKNU.jpg) ![20250922_174824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zff9iHrnd5nbNJWP6ZjJWH2qCmnqsfA6GWgnaHvCEsA6FsZY4QyUbWwPg2QjktwwKw.jpg) ![20250922_175315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A2UA8x7q2yJYKwpPUCHLMAHLrzX2MSRHB2SZEhVUkFAmQKhGTAKxTiFzhAporevfX7.jpg) ![20250922_175423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432BAUfB459GtVKPtx5uMEpjtiqMEJNHkL3vU43ugkCt1tX54WWSiU8FkwroZNE6vvtx.jpg) ![20250922_175749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zZRmLTELLXGgdGqwv9Z3ze7CPZ3inbAs93WZxzmd3L3imdbCsWDNymiMArAnGM3rxf.jpg) ![20250922_175427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z7Bd7GXnaK4RSM8Wtkh1WbrP93DiyJwtrgWm7fPSjMfsXPJmQcXKunS72BprdpSy3ub.jpg) ![20250922_175508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432FMRvVm3MLrD7biPLFx3pnaNbo1qQ8RMAZmkh3st5bQ2HT2xmY8qdktoHRs2TxT2A4.jpg) ![20250922_175606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odaD6XoUAXJKyHb462QeD44ExA6XXmDJZuXNEsBHAUZX6NE4MxqGH8EZa71YPyth3d.jpg) --- La Caleta beach is situated between Baños del Carmen beach, or rather, from a stretch of beach just beyond the latter, which forms part of Pedregalejo beach, and extends all the way to La Malagueta beach. It’s in the eastern part of the city, which I think is why it’s one of the most popular with tourists. The beaches in the western part are more family-oriented. The promenade that runs alongside it is the Pablo Ruiz Picasso Promenade. It’s a beach where, although there are plenty of tourists, it’s better maintained than La Malagueta, and over the years I’ve seen various improvements, such as pedestrian walkways and cycle paths, improvements that keep it in good condition and make it appealing to visitors. It is one of the beaches closest to the city centre, which I think is why it is the second most popular choice. --- ![20250922_180016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUGWny88uFHNdNmWMS6nB1sbKGuRwe4Qr3ydumv83BSHJrnX473EfkKsZzZcJ2cSq5P.jpg) ![20250922_180021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241tWyhRV5zsHzBEra6P8BnrcMaePG11Bp1TpNXn13UGXBjrPnE4kxzmLayMefYcCWMtp.jpg) ![20250922_175555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMWDtMTsfswoi64BEVaYMYbzWEKa6oHxMZ2PiwUeWQy6kRho4CXqYLrzgKKgTeBFxaB.jpg) ![20250922_180149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fp1KW4S2KDpCCRgij5Z8bJshbvgFqDvTT9sDLSAQYwhPXqWtxvHVEqRNYNhGPHtG4d.jpg) ![20250922_180248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A4viRH6V6x9nXFCAJbXK1ur2QfzkfczEDDotV3QYRwTxq65zkTQyBHZpcaobNnrqsz.jpg) ![20250922_180143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sJrT1w2RL4atARwnQfmrdsGN99g7SmK49fwMuj14iB46ENJ1gavm5JEDwyk781egp7M.jpg) ![20250922_180332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241Zt6hpZRRPj2PuCw2tnx5vNm5VCuicGEAug7nMhQZi1STsu8oT4UZDKXx6qLTi9Fo7M.jpg) --- In the past, it was also a quiet beach used for fishing, like so many others in the eastern part of the city, but there have been so many improvements that the difference from the others is now very noticeable, particularly in the buildings, structures and even the sand. As I mentioned, every so often along the stretch there is a beach bar with very modern restaurants, each with its own style, and I think this is one of the things that sets it apart the most. --- ![20250922_180432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ujmxJM9HUgfQDW7YA8r86WHFCTCBWkjMhK1vgwuWxkHQoEoPHPn3sd9DVNFEhrxu4YG.jpg) ![20250922_180255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fpTSMdc1gY4VGGzzKWRgQnQ16bR67M2nbBHep1QtSyKLmBW6UYk1jS5BQ27fh68fhP.jpg) ![20250922_180726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245myNMWC8UehzYV5M9KaEvEd2SNpifgMemRg18xcrXHu8FSySL6aB9ea6DKCYu6o6YWq.jpg) ![20250922_180530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eGkUdcfQvXyuo4QnK7AA7cXsiao62tfZ2d1eZg8kiAY4wHmcWSije79Lrf3VBdZ14x.jpg) ![20250922_180526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244y1hGVZtHggo5cGgcSmhsubDQzyBY7eTxE1fE1nFgKPsNk129ZNGztUwk9e8iwetyMt.jpg)
![20250922_180604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqs27pQv4Hjw2hXxh1V3NKp59rtETXJMm8cymURwuXFKidVaHS9QoKrkpScjZyuqY5t.jpg)
![20250922_180608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Y9vRfhuACFGkWJ2u6rim5RtVKxe5sDkNKH3L4bAzG1wk7tGkrHUrw63W76KyeGQbtu.jpg) --- It shares its name with, or derives its name from, the neighbourhood nearby, which was once a very affluent area, home to the bourgeoisie, particularly in the late 19th century. The beach is part of a luxury residential area; indeed, one of the finest hotels, the five-star Hotel Miramar, is situated very close by, overlooking the sea. ![6311.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23vsG1tWzw9QuQt2aqVgFC8JxMYmPNgnJB3jYNGfVbAEqGXgTSucEojcR5J8Ho85BMsKT.png)


Easter Sunday is usually a time for family. We have egg hunting, games, and music  celebration in our town. But this time, our family wants it differently.





After several days of strong winds and  we made the most of the beautiful weather. Taking advantage of the beautiful clear skies and  we decided to go for an outdoor adventure. We packed our bags with food and water and put on our hiking shoes. 

![5183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpnCKo5wncTJYSbSyNaRzmeDSCXNp2ak7aXqyGwFLT5YwuSDT71fgWei4ZqanU2o9nt.jpg)

And we went to the cuha-völgy in Hungary for another hiking nature adventure.


![5411.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23xp1yHHZzWuJEDwp3HqPKtMrx4p9YrkaX6xTDRAhgD73REAG2DQrQJY3E2VMvMrqknJn.png)

The weather that morning was perfect for any outdoor activities. We started our journey at 10 in the morning. We're on the  
Monostor bridge, driving to Hungary. 



![5304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpVACRZ68RAh51mvoUBBHVshcBiwKyDtdujYcj6RJD6HKPbyCKsow63NF9ojxgb3ns1.jpg)


The weather was perfect, the deep blue sky wide with just a few clouds.  When we got there, the parking area was busy- lots of hikers were getting ready too.




The small village gather for Easter Celebration. Ferris wheel and carousel in the big lots. Families gather together for an Easter Egg Hunting. Aside from that, ice cream shops and buffets are open for the celebration.


![6309.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23xyTCYmE1y1YznVs8vvgBiZJ6uiY9BFQVZJHJxcXTauuxshWDPb1B6Q4MbevLuBg4yWU.png)

Our bags were ready and started our hiking adventure. The fresh forest air immediately welcomed us. It was refreshing and calm- exactly what we needed after days of crazy winds. It was a place where we could relax and enjoy simple moments together.


![5193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpC9V2kbvCtszTdEMXqj45kqaAdtKqv7BJkct6aD1UYeYpYp1HtpiBETkLDKJnTSUC7.jpg)

![5192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wqiSGnG9XKGpVQXS1XShKwaW8wab71FpE5Yay6Pv1K8uieymZeQp32o5NmT5SzHFVrU.jpg)


![5212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoAaHdvrB5RaAV6S7zJFnkKbruHAkJptSKcx57AjaiGSd6m7fyfrFAS2TCo2sfpHqwD.jpg)

![5213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5mgxPoDteqeJWynPPgNFCFLkxnshu8WAtFEM6VBxw8jRu8wiN5ti1Cm6seaPZAqoY.jpg)

![5215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23xyR3h8hEyKV1yHhfqbRmx74AhfK5gC9msFHfpmGoUCJyfakAvjWoNeFTuzpY9PTz3QW.jpg)


![5190.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5mJZAdYXxCw2TFvJMZH5MEQDcssex3zB5qkQCFE6JG9TJvgRVK8xVBGKKyqojToFa.jpg)

We reached a small stream and the water sparkled under the sunlight . It was the first small stream and more to come as our trail will be more challenging.


![5337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Eou9CG8tXCrNVG6bvKiE8qWV8tEXyKJb4TnCj9iiYEncuqGYN8YvdJkWWFDJSutL2NR.jpg)

![5336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23tSYH5dEAfLwgMv6CsjtEHqfm6yxRBeofGhXLkQKBKNkWmLahcdcJw9sd8zhrpYigDo1.jpg)

![5211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EorzmCPKVce3tPwFkE7QTvWL2YSSe9SrC3vGvNr8q3zgsZ1s2p3c7jMH5hsuY9wF1XP.jpg)

We continued our walk, and the kids and I chose to cross the stream on a big fallen tree. And my husband just carefully stepped on stones to cross the water.


As we walked through the valley, the water was so crystal clear and we fully appreciate the beauty of nature. Tall trees surrounded us that made the area feel calm and relaxing.


![5265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpXJa4rCgxYbZLThoVHYgYCFZpgkXx2ZKGNLoRR1brFZoU3hCEMZQBV4WjC5iQNNj6a.jpg)



What I loved most about Cuha Valley was its stunning natural surroundings. And the towering rock formations added a breathtaking view to the landscape. Some visitors were not just to hike but also to climb. We saw kids challenge themselves by climbing the steep rock walk. It was really an adventure.


Our experience was even more relaxing and the air felt cool and refreshing.



![5235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5nG1winFEMqJjg1i2Xq1EM8Kp7S1ZgVPnCf6XyM18yw5ia6tsxj1aB8zuM3kpYrEt.jpg)

![5263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Eokd5DEP4wG7YYTFKeDPx9vPMYrSBmtJynWyyvKMLuvLKL8eaSwhw3wh5q6yNhczN53.jpg)

![5244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpNnNUEMjAsFQhTUixRGBJTDpXuQ2V2N4YLBgnJcnnVnWWDt5nGm63muw3XmUXXwFGv.jpg)

![5269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpvhP8Td8zYbRFS7Ryw2xcZCfik4J6CAMLdF1Q8u9mYsQEMUCZ9wCfSSsD49kd47Y35.jpg)

![5270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wCEDgyyrHsxaM5vtxRp8wohJFUUMy3grckpzc7rKpkPo6W79q5tAJp6Das4eCdPmT3W.jpg)



The place was made even more unique because of the railway and its tunnel. To reach the railway, we need to climb the stairs. After seeing the tunnel, we went down stairs and we were lucky to see the train pass over the tunnels above and added a special charm in the place 

The old stone bridge arched and human engineering felt nature blended on it together.



It was easy to follow the trail, with the wooden paths, marked routes and the water stream guiding us along the way.



![5298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23zGa4Ri56cUdFFNE2qMJGMYirR8W5a5ecKjYnjyQsYmEXET6oBtz3dJ7BEN4XjTMrnG2.jpg)

![5297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Epviu4UL5Y62iJ5zWWKns6DosV9UrEmvDMkwSw16fsbAPXGgJUiR1h3sJyrW46WRLMN.jpg)

![5294.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23w2iu8sD9Qg4mPC2b5d4Z3tpLiPfQW1meNAF1Lh5Rfx1FTRdUtrKvnhvECuniUQ3DFGz.jpg)


Along the way, we discovered small caves that added to the adventure. And one of the highlights was the Kőpince Cave. Its natural rock openings added a unique charm to the hike. Every adventure we have becomes a chance to discover new places as a family. Hiking gives us a quality time that brings us closer- we talk, laugh and enjoy each other's company. Another memories added to our lists this year.





![5229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23ynNRq3eg6CNkLXttMpnPqUXdhEee9jY6BR8AVtr9swCDkbnjAoorQXuQ5orxNmTV7Kz.jpg)

![5231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wCDijTtdNWLiktFRQaSLsYYCvgFjFeeq5yYkmyWXZgnkj6S1JgUHT6ZG8qC2vKvF33h.jpg)




What I love most  about the places like Cuha Valley is the sound of water, tall trees and the cool fresh wind.

The quiet place that makes you slow down and just breathe. The most important thing is to feel grateful that my kids discover the rocks, streams and tunnels.

Holidays don't need to be grand. And sometimes the simplest days become the most meaningful ones. We skipped the egg hunt and our Easter hike turned into a family memories we'll keep FOREVER.
 

![5334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoptKbd4fiiGaT2P5Yq87Em6D3Uu8v2QSjsnooz9xN7BxUzVm4pVCz4kxThyfZrrq6Y.jpg)


We went on our own adventure and discovered the beautiful nature. And Cuha Valley is definitely worth exploring. 
![1749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23tw1RGcyG27D9fJmVnFfCmG49kya1HDGeGX6bkVtCrjLYB42YuYbAaPF7YTHHQ77mo1j.jpg)

‎We visited Burok-burokan Hidden Spring Resort, and it is definitely one of the most popular spots.
‎
‎As soon as we arrived, the parking area inside was already full.
‎
‎So we parked at a private space nearby for ₱50/$0.84.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbf4r2E4Ta3Ek1pDYz3r681jkPq8S1ZSPWMdNH8mt8q5/1776608128004.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbkxe3EVyk9grSQSLzF7vhLwhXxkoRxaeCJTyW2ZoSkbC/1776608128192.jpg)

‎Walking towards the entrance, we paid ₱70/$1.26 per head for the entrance fee, while the kids were free of charge. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRrbjZwFgSN6xTNiszH28ToGeQ8YS9hnRPpePddcMwW2/1776608162007.jpg)

‎To be honest, this is quite a significant change compared to before. I remember that in the past, the entrance fee was only ₱25/$0.42 pesos here, and now, it jumped all the way to ₱70/$1.26... It's quite a huge increase! 
‎
‎And it's very noticeable.
‎
‎Stepping inside, the first thing I noticed was the sheer number of people. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEQPkkGzmyuFn5VKw3tdh4ApkekRhpLvcW2twbwu4Tpi/1776608254838.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxx1X5D6FMRJGcpDCw8JqfagPqwcEGK8Ju3qT25R8W2v/1776608255042.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5P1vUMyMseoqNHQX6p6meHXmDZM5aEJorBiXivuwv2s/1776608255338.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9MMLwMWdHJu2nDffPXV6CybQERJW9nrgm4dsJHvjKU6/1776608255595.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsykQLcU7jALbBwjDtHqkhquDFNGJ2oG8ViHeMUD6ttu/1776608255903.jpg)

‎I have visited this place before, and it was already crowded back then.
‎
‎Yet the number of visitors this time seemed to have multiplied! 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTawQj2vbD6zfCiWN9Bhotey9dnAGcUgKMk55bTtR2yZx/1776608305303.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1mXw4hHPyzHGvxveE13iTiK3mf9aequmRxk6TDt51a1/1776608305526.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZof6Pwc8KUDWLbUiyz1W9BrrGNj9iVyXXKiupFZoFyJG/1776608305792.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2HyZGB8iR9k69KfpNJdFm85rpynGKh7JUqa6u7kHoAL/1776608306040.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4ADnqD5C3xByTLH5uUpALESaLAV4cnMbPmvK14nHWEC/1776608306359.jpg)
‎
‎The atmosphere was lively and every single cottage was already rented out. 
‎
‎Every corner was occupied.
‎
‎People were everywhere... swimming in the pools, sitting down to enjoy meals, chatting with friends and family, and of course, taking countless selfies and group photos to capture the memories. 
‎
‎It was a bit of a challenge finding space at first. 
‎
‎We weren't sure where to place our bags or where to sit because the area was so packed. 
‎
‎Thankfully, we managed to locate our group of friends quickly on the left side. They were able to secure a spot with tables and chairs, which was enough for us to settle in despite the limited space.
‎
‎Despite the crowd and the price changes, the experience was still amazing.
‎
‎Mainly because of the water itself. 
‎
‎It's the best feature of Burok-Burokan... the water flows directly from a natural stream. That's why it is so fresh, icy cold, and crystal clear.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhTVh8oNdScnoE4sZxMCowFJBK9TLUVfsjYP6x4PnXND/1776608362255.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2NEhQVwriFXu5j7nHX4dWwarDrme11R1EbZ6dHWmYCb/1776608362492.jpg)

‎Unlike typical swimming pools that rely on chlorine and chemicals for cleaning, here the water is naturally clean because of its continuous flow. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVyPBpJ29zTGjMfaPRi5KrJk9wm6C47wc2u2dBHJKDPbx/1776608389550.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRU1MAU4hJHjxn6Z4pbdV7mXwwfmzfFSAMvvnfKZoj1Rf/1776608389717.jpg)

‎It feels so refreshing on the skin and is perfect for cooling down.
‎
‎The resort also has 3 different pools, designed for both kids and adults. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGQsU7KgBErnfLAM6J7WTbEDgRmNqyHgW6MP8auMGgJN/1776608563822.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQSNpQCQooJzar8FQXMa11sm4CJp9JGnzeu31NchFBjH/1776608564098.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWerXvhkkmgxXx7LTsRSNzDcx4cMVDiri46kk3xuYhPLj/1776608564361.jpg)

‎There are shallow areas for the little ones and deeper sections for adults. 
‎
‎Because of this setup, even with the large volume of people, everyone still had enough room to swim and enjoy.
‎
‎Another thing I love about this place is the environment. 
‎
‎It is surrounded by plenty of tall trees and greenery. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP26Q6p2Y5qWz1o6BUS1XWk8vLgXanF1bG18WreZinXWX/1776608638062.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhHs42ikMqHJ29J637Aaa7W1DsxHEAz51LWmVvYQJuYu/1776608638286.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzAhW7FkMTKu3nB6s5PigDRZRY9swEtkvrubCPHHyE8Y/1776608638571.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHxNHuWY2HkhfXTnY6BtLntFgd8E6HkXmV8vMWZvhBMx/1776608638799.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7enmyvz8ctAg93tQLhVpkKgakUNyJEpBH1pQwZDKURa/1776608639028.jpg)

‎This provides excellent natural shade, making the atmosphere cool and breezy.
‎
‎So even though it was already afternoon... we didn't feel the intense heat of the sun because the trees covered us. 🌳

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsYJi3s5z9ScLh6nyorPKxfC2BDFbXUyNVPD88BHaiG4/1776608701123.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZuKV9SVEYGLTFPaJ9p5wFwhG8MWkQmPTgMzP7VKmk365/1776608701378.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZfHBBqtqoA9qMF5KyZhm54utxyA5aQ1u36WPtZoEmXL/1776608701646.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbeNjnSysKZ9X37p4y2aXgRuXLwGCtwR81VtE1XCQhKA/1776608701951.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUqSMSeDumx5xRpvFs2tCisyuXj2tqfgErFiredqG6gwf/1776608702208.jpg)

‎Burok-Burokan Hidden Spring Resort is proof that natural attractions are still the best. 
‎
‎The combination of naturally cold flowing water and the lush environment makes it a perfect getaway. 
‎
‎Yes, it can get very crowded, and the entrance fee has increased quite a bit from the old ₱25/$0.42 rate to ₱70/$1.26 now, but the fun and the refreshing experience make it all worth it! 👍🏻✨
‎
‎Until my next place to unwind...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1776608752250.png)

After my first few days of prayer and reflection in Mecca, I started to discover the daily life around the Holy Mosque. Many people focus only on the religious side, but there is also a very modern and social side to Mecca that I found very interesting. I want to tell you about two specific experiences: a beautiful cafe visit and my dinner at the most famous fast-food chain in the country.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcevHwYh8eFFqUfkALcvhzxXJ8kTVGv9E62XTPyqZ6aSE/img_0493.jpg)


**A Sanctuary with a View: The Holy Cafe**

In Mecca, the heat and the crowds can be very intense. Sometimes, you need a place to sit quietly and just process everything you are seeing. I found a cafe that felt like a hidden gem. It was located very close to the Masjid al-Haram. In fact, it was so close that when I sat down at my table, I was looking directly at the walls of the Kaaba.
The interior of the cafe was very modern and stylish. It had large glass windows that offered a panoramic view of the holy area. Sitting there with a hot drink in my hand, watching the thousands of people circling the Kaaba, was a very emotional experience. It made me realize how small we are in this world, yet how connected we all are.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWu6MfUjoFXJ1CorgypAV9goysYFbvorfsj3c9hrDHopo/img_0183.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwQwFX2nfZyeGBeGho9NiqrPVjzn46mhkuWfSfBTWmn1/img_0184.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfHZq6EMj7gULuikBdfMDc2JHn31wX59SGCMok3YfEryg/img_0185.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtorwavhjJTz9kmX6pGA64KA4VCU6jwYuUjuBdPtxRoC/img_0197.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwYNtZqPLT1cov5n7V5DadxuQx2rNytX5FL3iv8ZQMcA/img_0199.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTePwnxPHo3XJ3BoRh4QnyeBQYwXpckG4rz5o6NTvyQd/img_0485.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma3XHnqyBrY1quV523Dy2DaYkG29TZHreWegG6NGTAF7z/img_0486.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1d3vyvkTiqyFKCkjEB8caBM6yLLofbGEAZxdnF1nTCC/img_0487.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpzLgzm5RvLh5mEPoFxZWTrphmkTeX9xDWToq3hcRDio/img_0488.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkM1hNcHUAPprBu3Fhd6w6BLrgP7Zc8jGxbdFAUoSs6g/img_0489.jpg)


One of the best things about this cafe was the price. Usually, when you go to a place with the "best view in the city," you expect to pay a lot of money. However, in this cafe, the prices were very reasonable. I shared some photos of the menu so you can see for yourselves. It wasn't just a place to drink coffee; it was a place to find peace while staying connected to the heart of the city. I spent a long time there, just observing the architecture and the movement of the crowd. It was much better than staying in the hotel room because even while resting, I was still part of the atmosphere.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme6J89swfD29isj1MEgewuSpoe8m78qDLqLaejWd5GboQ/img_0188.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZwDwSTrrN3Rn4Luovgqe2HRis8HEjPCzqYUXupYiBqe/img_0190.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVreLywbTkXwXp8jDNSEcBsd8JQhEk3MjiyEVfumQm3S/img_0191.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefoJPtmdf7ew29kdKCFkSPTGkLzv4tSfjkx5Ye9rDWpD/img_0186.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaZhfMEZ1zau1N8xVeBueuHNiRhgVRtMRaGeKoSGqS18/img_0195.jpg)


**The Al Baik Mystery: Is It Really That Good?**

If you ask anyone in Saudi Arabia where to eat, they will tell you "Al Baik." It is a legendary fast-food brand here. People wait in long lines, and everyone talks about it like it is the best chicken in the world. Naturally, I was very curious. I had to try it.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafHEg598bqhc99ggZjWiGWXsCHtwqECzA1wpkTejxpMX/img_0349.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQM6tVXiBDPDvKSH6V6dUZDyyidRjReLWVFipAhxeExzQ/img_0350.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNYcNydcvPkjbPGzzDfn5oG62DbSV4aNcnCW2mvGDP8dR/img_0351.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNad1Jja138ewKnS5HKPzmrc2FNY3suqaXLwtGqcSo3Z4/img_0352.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRpJoNZu6Y7QK8bj5v1FYVY13epCuwHSGE3RRwnFaUhn/img_0354.jpg)


When I arrived at the Al Baik branch, the first thing I noticed was the organization. The culture here is very different from Turkey or Europe. There are completely separate sections for men and women to order. As a woman, I went to the ladies' section to get my food. It was very crowded, which made me think, "Okay, this must be amazing."


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNM4PzaFD6zYRACcMifkDKYX7qrTABFeWgA6iEQUfGEA8/img_0373.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRwwED1wFo6DubWCprxwQ4reK5N8pkJT2EYEAnbxSgNJQ/img_0374.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLDsizrhY2k6TQyWEHpB5kzW5Ku8A6TwoqGYwcAYKcx5/img_0372.jpg)


However, when I finally got my food, I was a little disappointed. To be very honest with you, it tasted like a normal chicken nugget. It was good and fresh, but it wasn't the "legendary" taste I was expecting. I think it might be a bit overrated because of the fame.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVFhh9G65p8CSqAVrNwToPYgEXb4DBeBH4kfmpr1ZoUv/img_0673.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJt6ZNDsioZH95P5dTTYG1LCW2VMXycuqxSnvbdQEpxG/img_0672.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesZcfzoEjs1td7PetNEHjFJVxpgz4j5kmaGDdZoz4Gn6/img_0671.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcNxSkBZpk6WwfTS7iKJEBbCkyhxne59hEzcEqGHumTp6/img_0678.jpg)


The way they serve the food was the most interesting part for me. In most places, if you order a meal, it comes as a sandwich or everything is in one box. At Al Baik, they give you everything separately. They give you the chicken nuggets in one package, the bread rolls in another, the French fries in another, and the garlic sauce in a separate container. It’s like a DIY (Do It Yourself) meal. You have to put it together or eat them one by one. It was a very different fast-food experience. While I didn't find the taste to be life-changing, I'm glad I tried it because it is such a huge part of the local culture in Mecca and Medina.

**Reflections on Local Life**

Being in Mecca taught me that life there is a balance. You have the most sacred place on Earth at the center, but right next to it, you have modern cafes, shopping malls, and busy restaurants.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFZo9kgcdLMDxKW5FNdi7ddmWDjpLTC1RJzCEY26o7MW/img_0375.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRvPxZnS7AzpakdseAx9t2UKXyHG4zf7x8opfTBDsx8u8/img_0363.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkpaMd7rzBBuehoZ8bz8dekHEEqnkjjokhkzR8QWX3Tj/img_0358.jpg)


I preferred spending my time in these public spaces rather than sitting in the hotel. Even though the hotels are very nice and comfortable, they feel isolated. By sitting in that cafe or visiting a local restaurant like Al Baik, I felt more connected to the people. I enjoyed watching families from different countries eating together and pilgrims from all over the world taking a break.

Mecca is a city that never sleeps. Whether it is 3:00 AM or 3:00 PM, the streets are full, the cafes are open, and the energy is high. This energy is what allowed me to survive on only 3 or 4 hours of sleep. You don't want to miss a single moment.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU7gW2thjWPsrgvr9iuFSqEDmRE8PBSXoGQEjvJuTWt8R/img_0273.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXtdKWHTdV4vtEZ3DkdEatQJrqLWWR66fLPyYNXdrCDup/img_0532.jpg)


In my next post, I will take you with me to Medina. The vibe there is completely different—much more quiet and peaceful. But for now, I will cherish these memories of the busy, magnificent, and surprising streets of Mecca. Thank you for following my journey!

I have visited the Ritan Park at the beginning of April on a work day as I was in Beijing city for my visa passport renewal. The park is located in the Chaoyang district and I went to the same area as most of the foreign embassies are located in this district in the Beijing. Also, it was a rainy day without sun in the sky and as a s result the day was not so bright as it is usually during this springtime of the year. The views of the entire park are so empty at first glance, as the gate I used was the south gate, which was not so popular for entry, I think. I have not covered all the areas of the park, as I was on my way to the institute after I had my work done in the embassy in the afternoon. But in the short visit, I found this beautiful spot in the park with a large pond and so many rocks surrounding the pond area, making it a great attraction for the visitors. I have entered the park from the south gate, which is on the same road as the embassy road that I have visited, and found this interesting section on the left side of the park. I have not selected the right direction because that direction is far away from my final destination to catch the bus to return home. So, I wanted to go towards the left side and exit from the park through the western gate. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNet3hci1ektvEfnUQwJf4S1zEaZRmXAmMdnXwd42LaUx/img_20260409_120534.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4p9E57SeappFDGyRuvuNNABPW8qkoW9nP1VNMd7GBZT/img_20260409_120714.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbzhdVmD9cXJe4xG5E3RpRwxsWyJiiycdDDGSaQVxPDq/img_20260409_120725.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5sQJ3anJNgYGCW24w5SUN2qvaaTuzit3JgEVmw9fjmo/img_20260409_120735.jpg) At a smaller distance, I found the spot, and it is a beautiful one, and I think the most beautiful spot of the whole park. The water of the pond is quite high due to the rainwater. The greenish surroundings of the park make it so attractive in this dry region. I saw a good number of visitors in this section, while other parts seemed to have very few people. I found many people interested in walking on the waterside stone way, where some of the stones are curved like you are in a world of stone caves, and the vibes are completely natural in this part of the water body. These are built with real stones, and some of the shapes and corners of the stones are decayed over time, with smooth rocky finishing, and such an attractive color combination of the stones. Though the day was a cloudy day bit this section is so vibrant with such amazing beauty. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYuaKUc3fJaBz13c3iC7GaJW6VeLNj3okGRr9oXQvP19u/img_20260409_120603.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmes2fkDVRmcHQAuLKxgxw4HdgrWPjM238qdKwXfTCpQ3G/img_20260409_120759.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAb9gEfMX5eaqyoczb2Z5hftgDidR8bBLxEy7Q8nBJ5i/img_20260409_120745.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcTYemFPaALjMBj7hZLQpS89t2NUKCsm3LytZFF79CvM/img_20260409_120748.jpg) I have also walked on the waterside way full of stones, and the surrounding nature was welcoming me. The natural beauty is so good that it is everywhere in such parks in Beijing, and when some water bodies are built near such amazing nature, the beauty of the place increases a lot, like this place. The overall area is completely neat and clean without any garbage. So, I enjoyed the fresh air and environment there under the bright sun. It was a pleasant experience. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNGtuqG6Zpd1DGw8ZpWhNpypwEjCLvSaFHDZWWxu8pai/img_20260409_120547.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVv47Cwgs4WGnkjRF1oiTRdXSDTPuh5AzDYYToh775WV/img_20260409_120638.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTq8p3KzW2NjnZL8txBEaijbZ98fbTYnYn5Puy6xxsE5A/img_20260409_120700.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWuRe2oPxpZgHmn4kN69k2cZACmo5cb3sUtvRuBSqaRF9/img_20260409_120708.jpg) I hope you enjoy my photos of Beijing's beautiful natural beauty of the Ritan Park in the Chaoyang district area on a spring afternoon after the rain. The soothing beauty of the spring afternoon is really great here with the greenish surrounding, with its serene beauty in this city area of the Chaoyang district. Hello there!

Having completed my earlier travel posts on several interesting countries and regions, including Japan, Maldives, Indonesia, US, Europe, New Zealand and the latest one being Australia, it's time to fly over to United Kingdom!

This was a trip I made in 2014, I was there partly for work and partly for leisure as well. At that point in my life, it was one of the further destination that I have travelled all the way from Asia and it was definitely an eye opener to see how United Kingdom, or more specifically London, looked like. One thing that I remembered vividly was how strong GBP was, and everything was so expensive. For example, even though the numerical digits of the prices were small, because 5 or 10 GBP was easily a lot already. Anyway, time to relive those moments as I share the sights and sounds of my experience!

Here are the posts so far:
[United Kingdom - Living The Football Dream With Chelsea](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-living-the-football-dream-with-chelsea)
[United Kingdom - The Beauty Of Art and Shopping In London](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-the-beauty-of-art-and-shopping-in-london)

[United Kingdom - Exploring Bath Abbey And Roman Baths](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@relf87/united-kingdom-exploring-bath-abbey-and-roman-baths)

***
We continued off from the beautiful Bath towards somewhere where I was super excited about! And that's the Stonehenge! I know some of you guys will say, ah these are just slabs or rocks and stones, but to me, it's a lot more than that! There's the artistic side of the structure, the history behind how this took place, and so much more to learn and admire about this place of interest!

The location of Stonehenge is quite out of nowhere and I caught these photos while we were on our way there.

<center>![20140615_153256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23sddkNvnNdWGHfoa6Cy9jT4smpKex7Sw5QGmBEYJG6nEaMmDi8uJpz4FaTKANntojSNG.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_153345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/245mwAB2QgKY419b2dSMPpT14cy1xaeUNET7FqUyGfmx41VDEzjjJvYuE23TdV3cRiD1z.jpg)</center>


And finally we arrived! There were a lot of people as expected but the space was definitely big enough for everyone to walk around and take some photos.

<center>![20140615_154846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/246RXarVFo13UGPTxzVay9omMN7db3janRhZm2r9mULf4MRZ6jv1TPHQav3JxPC71SrK6.jpg)</center>

So here's the Stonehenge! For the rest of the photos, I took them while I made the usual round about the entire Stonehenge, and it allowed me to see the different angles and viewpoints on the Stonehenge structure. After all, we already paid for the ticket hehe!


<center>![20140615_154955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23vPGzhx8gcU3K27YtGmDk8Rb9WY9QEfojv4nFPA9pDqjt6GDrPdB1ui9TUY4mLRXwHgB.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_155446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23sUGsdimGbz5KeE15TR2G2Wuc1Urw8znbdnap9iJwd2TNKpxpxiZ4p9Fge2ZyyfTGcMB.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_155536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23sddb4Z1NH9gkU64pNkDirWdGqjRsFwMmcmNGYEcUTcUcgoH7h6CZgaLjbwunRh97x7m.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_155622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/246G7MQXTt9wfL5bP5zjZsWz8p92jy7PH4q8cAmwNpVjHM8ANopyV9AYup7fYgXVHgRrY.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_155705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23v4VPWXkkvWwqkuEwsHGPxW7v89DkmDysn1umPrnsAc5gvFoGLN8bxbpVZa7dA9uvfPV.jpg)</center>

<center>![20140615_160157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/246GB5JtDWYkCSzyaMd9Ez2zVVBAnRcEWXhiRjpoQa6KJJhAoLBgvzUvXwZreZnDPSFKb.jpg)</center>

<center>![20140615_160456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23vPGqReAKoCtWap3oySz9N3qgS2FGNmobpd71H7SdEysLd7g66Dm39cR3CGbW6YrJtF3.jpg)</center>

So there was also another side where they had a visitor experience centre and it showcased some interesting history and information about the Stonehenge itself.

<center>![20140615_160944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23uQnVtAT41bAwJsuroPAGVCdYLc8eMH5FEh6xwwBnoDx1bBsJJ8ExZPeof2QQL9Rr5Q6.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_163153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23sdfAoF19EcboeyxTvhvbrZ2SjHQSRNvkvWe8FZpCynBQBeoku3u7iBBvJWxjENi4rJG.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_163307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23wC9MEw4Lke21apyxXu15obr8qwP8Bv74N61mGBMV6JbnsSTdbydnfyvEkBgRZhg8HjQ.jpg)</center>

Just look at the size of the slab of rock that somehow people had to transport and arrange back then!

<center>![20140615_163332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/243M5Sfw3bZHCmbiGL3kKu79EVMjgbXt2YDSM63ZXN7AvgRVzBEa9mKSFLe7UTTfCbdXW.jpg)</center>

They also had indoor areas where they had a digital screen which allowed visitors to see Stonehenge through the history (the structure did change due to nature forces) and through the seasons as well, which I thought was quite interesting.

<center>![20140615_163512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/243Lze22cB41iLCBwrhysEVhW4jVDUFfi9SPenD8Fj9avJSBYBVh6UTQu5qmRJGScweMj.jpg)</center>

<center>![20140615_163642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/242NexhxP6PFbrkM3mrzhewEVoxJRcMfCFEDeyoNZqQXmXSiCkaswL1SgpevfF7w2tCFv.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_163729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23wgPvSMzJicQWcWxa6vc6CisoYJz8WXPM4RLEoGsgsKPosT7nhT8XhHtBih29JbXv9sR.jpg)</center>

And no surprise, this is a World Heritage Site!

<center>![20140615_163815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/243fpTS2Fk7NdakMGagDZgwtQYuFSjVegez6NpRKUU2HL4UHGLyjmYjpEALW9nNDCRmFh.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_163822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/243M1EkKEK5yBDii1aGQm6ga4H3V2qb1FUpSegc7A3xWn712dHsT61M3gunBYamytpsmj.jpg)</center>


<center>![20140615_164358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23zGcie8xB5AK18zNHZCoQAMTVSFh5N9vkmTECFn2TpCjRw3JxhU4YHb3uAr6RPLTbyJi.jpg)</center>

And that's it for the tour of Stonehenge! Maybe it's just me, but I do feel these historical sites are magical in their own way, and it's fascinating to think of how these places were created and what their significance to the people back then was. I was excited before coming to Stonehenge and I definitely left the site feeling extremely satisfied and happy!

And that's all I have today! Have you been to Stonehenge or United Kingdom? Let me know in the comments below!

Finally, thanks for reading my post in the community under World Map Pin!
